legacyServePathAudit.method: Exact-symbol grep across artifacts/api-server/src plus manual read of brokerageNodeFacets.ts (the actual current serve route)
legacyServePathAudit.owner: HAS a real legacy path: loadOwnerFactAtom (ownerFactRead.ts), an atom-store read gated by Studio/Team entitlement at the ROUTE layer (callerGrantsOwnerFact), not the reader itself. This is the retirement candidate the b-slate1 template expects, but owner's parcel_record pipeline (cad_property Tier 1 + WCAD Tier 2) and its atom pipeline (owner-fact-writer.ts, also CAD-sourced but independently computed) are two separately-derived sources both claiming authority over the same field -- structurally the same shape as the dollar-rail situation that produced PARCEL-S6-COLLISION before those rails were allowed to slate. Per operator direction (2026-09-04 session), owner is held OUT of this wave pending its own dedicated reconciliation card, mirroring that precedent. Not shipped in any of the 5 PRs below.
legacyServePathAudit.otherFive: schoolDistrict, utilityService, overlayDistricts, agValuation, and maxImperviousCoverPct have NO legacy serve path anywhere in this repo -- confirmed by exact-symbol search and by reading brokerageNodeFacets.ts's own root-sibling field list before this lane's changes. Genuinely new-to-serve, matching the mission dispatch's own four-cell method (source-has/served-has): all five sit in the top-right 'THE GAP' cell, not the bottom-right. Each ships with a typed not-cut-over refusal as its 'legacy' branch instead of a call to a nonexistent reader -- an honest new state, not a defect.

contractDiscrepancy.finding: This lane's own dispatch named a binding contract: any field a consumer (Smart Site, Command Center) actually renders must flow through FactSheetResolver.resolve() (_catalog/parcel_fact_sheet_contract/CONTRACT_RULES.md, invariant I1), and must not build a second lookup path outside it. Exhaustive search (exact symbol names FactSheetResolver, ParcelFactSheet, bySheetId, composeVerdict, resolverVersion, and the contract file's own header-declared path packages/parcel-fact-sheet/src/index.ts) across BOTH legacy-design-tools and hauska-map found NO implementation anywhere -- only the canonical spec copy living in doc_repo's own _catalog/parcel_fact_sheet_contract/. Two readings, not adjudicated by this lane: (1) the contract is a frozen target-state spec for a still-in-flight UI refactor (lane SS-W1) that has not reached these fields yet, and the real current production path is brokerageNodeFacetsRouter (GET /api/brokerage/v1/place/node/:parcelNodeId/facets) -- confirmed to be exactly what the PARCEL-B-SLATE1 precedent (wells/specialDistricts/cityLimits, already live in production) actually built against; (2) the resolver is supposed to already exist and this lane simply could not find where. Per operator direction, this lane followed reading (1) -- the proven, shipped precedent over an aspirational contract doc -- and wired all five rails as root-sibling fields on brokerageNodeFacets.ts, exactly like the b-slate1 rails. Naming this rather than silently resolving it: if reading (2) is correct, every root-sibling field this lane and the b-slate1/b-slate2 lanes before it added (wells, specialDistricts, cityLimits, flood, owner, the six dollar/structural rails, and now these five) is a second lookup path the contract's own I1 invariant prohibits, and that is a finding for whoever owns the SS-W1 refactor's actual status, not something resolvable from this seat.
